title: Cardini 2018 maternal brain gain preprint trunk PPS
citation: Cardini, F., Fatemi-Ghomi, N., Gajewska-Knapik, K., Gooch, V., & Aspell, J. E. (2018). Maternal brain gain: enlarged representation of peripersonal space in pregnancy. bioRxiv 492017.
notes: The three visits repeat one 65-trial assessment. Inspect the five sound-relative timings and 15 audio-only catch trials per visit.

reported_source.type: Two copies of the same pink noise with opposing level envelopes.
reported_source.near_speaker_reference: Close to the left response hand.

reported_tactile_response.response: Press with the left hand promptly after touch and ignore sound.

reference_parameters.reported_analysis: Use session-specific delay-by-group ANOVAs and compare participant linear slopes within each session after excluding fits below R² .20.
reference_parameters.inspection_scope: One complete 65-trial timing pool for a chosen visit. Uses stationary uncalibrated pink noise and a generic touch marker. One software block and a fixed seed are inspection settings. Running it once does not instantiate the other visits.
implementation_gaps: Exact two-speaker audio files and calibrated exponential gains, azimuth, and body-referenced distances are unavailable.
Mechanical tapper drive, pulse duration, force calibration and synchronized response-device hardware are unverified.
Response deadline, precise foreperiod, end silence and intertrial timing are unreported.

provenance.field: Longitudinal visits, sounds, touch, response and trial allocation
provenance.source: https://doi.org/10.1101/492017, pp. 8–10, Participants, Procedure and Fig. 2
